title: Management of Adrenal Emergency in Germany
brief_summary: The management of adrenal crisis is often problematic and the time to adequate treatment is frequently delayed.The aim of the study is to evaluate the management of adrenal emergencies requiring parenteral glucocorticoid treatment by a prospective multicenter study in patients with chronic adrenal insufficiency.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years
* Documented chronic adrenal insufficiency
* Established corticosteroid replacement therapy
* Written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Age \<18 years
study_population: Patients aged ≥18 years with a documented chronic adrenal insufficiency under established corticosteroid replacement therapy.
